nissan-leaf-plus-2024.summary: The US 2024 long-range Leaf is the SV PLUS. The EPA listing abbreviates it to LEAF SV; the 149-mile S is a different battery configuration.
nissan-leaf-plus-2024.decision: For a used Leaf, ask for battery-health information and inspect charging access on your regular routes. Do not use the range of a newer-generation Leaf to plan trips in this model.
nissan-leaf-plus-2024.charging: The 2024 SV PLUS uses a CHAdeMO DC quick-charge port, rated up to 100 kW in Nissan’s brochure. The previous CCS label was incorrect. Check for a working CHAdeMO connector at every planned stop; a CCS listing alone does not establish compatibility.

kia-ev6-wind-rwd-long-range-2025.summary: The 2025 long-range rear-wheel-drive EPA entry is the appropriate reference for this Wind RWD page. AWD and GT ratings belong to other configurations.
kia-ev6-wind-rwd-long-range-2025.decision: Verify model year and drivetrain on the window sticker before comparing an older EV6 listing. For commute planning, leave a charging reserve instead of assuming the full combined rating is available on every highway journey.
kia-ev6-wind-rwd-long-range-2025.charging: EPA 240V charging times below describe the tested configuration and equipment. Your home supply and onboard charger can change the time. For a road trip, check the vehicle manual and station compatibility; the peak charging rate is not the session average.

chevrolet-silverado-ev-work-truck-2025.decision: Ask for the WT code and onboard charging equipment before comparing trucks. Payload, trailer aerodynamics and route elevation require a separate towing plan; these unladen combined ratings are not towing ranges.

subaru-solterra-touring-2025.decision: Touring equipment does not create a longer EPA range than Limited. Compare comfort equipment and condition separately, then check whether your daily route leaves sufficient reserve in winter.

rivian-r1s-dual-motor-max-pack-2025.decision: Match both wheel size and tire package before using a range figure. The 410-mile 22-inch reference should not be carried over to the 370-mile All-Terrain version. Reserve extra energy for roof cargo and towing.

land-rover-defender-110-phev-2025.summary: The Defender 110 PHEV combines a petrol engine and rechargeable battery. Electric-only range must be kept separate from total driving range; it is not a battery-electric Defender.
land-rover-defender-110-phev-2025.decision: The 2025 technical specification separates P400e and P300e. Confirm the engine code: P400e is listed at 44–51 km and P300e at 44–50 km under WLTP. Options and conditions affect the result.
land-rover-defender-110-phev-2025.charging: Land Rover lists 19.2 kWh total and 15.4 kWh usable battery capacity. Its stated home-charge time is 2 hours 30 minutes at 7 kW; the DC entry specifies 40 kW equipment. Confirm charging equipment for the exact car.

jeep-recon-standard-range-2026.summary: The existing URL says Standard Range, but we have not verified that trim against an official certification. The previous 280-mile claim has been withdrawn from this page.
jeep-recon-standard-range-2026.decision: The EPA database identifies a 2026 Recon MOAB 4WD at 222 miles. That is a different named configuration and is shown only as a reference. Request the actual window sticker before using a range, battery or price figure for a Standard Range listing.
jeep-recon-standard-range-2026.charging: Do not plan a trip using the former catalog charging numbers. Confirm the delivered trim, connector and charging instructions in the vehicle documentation.

mercedes-benz-eqa-250-plus-2025.summary: The EQA 250+ is a European-market reference on this site. The former 255-mile EPA label was unsupported and has been removed.
mercedes-benz-eqa-250-plus-2025.decision: Mercedes’ UK technical reference lists 311–346 miles between least and most efficient specifications for the AMG Line Premium derivative. Confirm the derivative and model-year documentation; this does not establish one universal EQA 250+ range.
mercedes-benz-eqa-250-plus-2025.charging: Ask for the exact car’s charging specification and connector details. US EPA ratings and US dollar prices should not be inferred from a UK EQA listing.

honda-eny1-2025.summary: Honda’s August 2025 UK product guide gives the e:Ny1 up to 256 miles under WLTP. The earlier 193-mile EPA label did not represent a verified EPA test.
honda-eny1-2025.decision: Use the WLTP rating for comparisons with other European specifications. It is not an EPA-equivalent result and is not a measured winter or motorway range.
honda-eny1-2025.charging: Honda specifies approximately 45 minutes from 10% to 80% using a 100 kW charger. This is a charging window under stated test conditions, not a claim that the car accepts 100 kW throughout.

audi-q6-etron-performance-2025.summary: The performance designation is used for Audi’s rear-wheel-drive European Q6 e-tron. Audi’s launch reference gives up to 641 km WLTP; the former 321-mile EPA label mixed market specifications.
audi-q6-etron-performance-2025.decision: Check that the car is the SUV performance version, not quattro, Sportback or a US-market Q6. Keep the market and test cycle consistent when comparing range.
audi-q6-etron-performance-2025.charging: Audi describes a 100 kWh battery for this launch configuration. Treat that as the stated pack capacity, not an independently verified usable-energy measurement. Confirm AC and DC limits for the actual vehicle.

audi-a6-etron-performance-2025.summary: This reference covers the A6 Sportback e-tron performance in Audi’s February 2025 European specification. Its quoted WLTP range is 673–756 km, depending on configuration.
audi-a6-etron-performance-2025.decision: Sportback and Avant are different body styles. Confirm the body style, wheels and market before comparing a listing; the former single EPA-labelled figure did not identify those choices.
audi-a6-etron-performance-2025.charging: Use the vehicle-specific charging documentation for session planning. A range rating alone does not establish battery capacity or a 10–80% charging time.

nio-et5-100kwh-2025.summary: NIO’s June 2025 European information gives the ET5 up to 590 km WLTP with the 100 kWh battery. This is not a US EPA rating.
nio-et5-100kwh-2025.decision: Verify the 100 kWh pack and whether the sale includes the battery or a separate subscription. Compare the sedan with the sedan; ET5 Touring is a different body style.
nio-et5-100kwh-2025.charging: For public charging or battery swapping, check local service availability and the battery agreement for the car. A nominal 100 kWh pack label alone does not establish usable energy or session time.

byd-tang-awd-2025.summary: BYD’s newer European Tang specification pairs a 108.8 kWh battery with up to 530 km WLTP range. The catalog had retained an older 86.4 kWh specification.
byd-tang-awd-2025.decision: Identify the battery generation when comparing a 2025 registration. The newer specification should not be applied automatically to an older-stock Tang or another market’s version.
byd-tang-awd-2025.charging: BYD specifies 170 kW DC charging and a 30–80% time of 30 minutes for this configuration. The starting charge matters: this is not a 10–80% result.

mg-mg4-ev-long-range-2025.summary: MG’s original UK 64 kWh Long Range specification distinguishes SE at 281 miles from Trophy at 270 miles under WLTP. The page’s broad Long Range name does not identify the equipment grade.
mg-mg4-ev-long-range-2025.decision: Confirm SE versus Trophy and the 64 kWh battery when evaluating a 2025 car. Newer MG4 revisions and the Extended Range version should be compared using their own documentation.
mg-mg4-ev-long-range-2025.charging: Check the handbook for the exact model year’s AC and DC charging limits. A higher advertised charger output does not mean the battery accepts that power through the full session.

sources.title: MG UK original Long Range specifications

mg-mg4-ev-xpower-2025.summary: MG’s original European XPOWER specification uses a 64 kWh battery and a 385 km WLTP range. The former 249-mile figure was not a verified EPA rating.
mg-mg4-ev-xpower-2025.decision: XPOWER uses a dual-motor AWD configuration. Do not use the higher range of a rear-wheel-drive Long Range MG4 for this version; verify that the seller’s model-year specification matches the reference.
mg-mg4-ev-xpower-2025.charging: Check charging specifications separately from motor power. The high output of the drive motors is not a DC charging rating.

variants.name: Original European MG4 XPOWER, 64 kWh AWD

vinfast-vf9-plus-extended-2025.summary: VinFast’s US specification separates VF9 Eco at 330 miles from Plus at 291 miles. The Plus page previously borrowed the Eco figure.
vinfast-vf9-plus-extended-2025.decision: The cited specification sheet is dated 2024 and supports the trim distinction, not a separately verified 2025 certification. Confirm the model-year label and seating configuration on the car before relying on the figure.
vinfast-vf9-plus-extended-2025.charging: Ask for the correct owner documentation and battery specification for the delivered car. Do not infer charging performance from the Eco trim’s range.
